clips.title: The story
paras: WRIGGLE. is an encounter with an excitable young slime that loves to dance until it runs out of energy. To revive and befriend the creature, an adventurer must fetch a special batch of nutritious sludge from the canals of the Undercity.

WRIGGLE. involves interacting with a lively, excitable little slime that delights in mirroring the dance movements of friendly travelers. Despite its enthusiasm, dancing quickly exhausts the small ooze, leaving it weary and in need of sustenance to restore its strength.

To revitalize the tuckered-out creature, adventurers must seek out Nutritious Slime Sludge, a peculiar mixture sold within the rancid canals of the Undercity. Upon absorbing this favored foul treat, the energized slime eagerly bonds with its provider, ready to follow its new friend.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The little slime seems delighted and is attempting to mirror your motions as you dance. It begins to look weary though.
The little slime hovers over a bit of sludge and absorbs it, looking slightly rejuvenated.
It seems all of this dancing has tuckered it out. Perhaps someone in the Undercity canals sells more of this nutritious sludge?

clips.title: Completion
paras: The slime shudders with newfound energy. It seems to want to follow you, now that it has associated you with food.
